notes: Nintendo of Europe 'Nintendo History' Technical Details page; axes labelled by Nintendo (Width, Depth, Height), so body.width=260, body.depth=190, body.height=73 as printed. The page does not say whether projecting parts are excluded: excludes_projections null. Mass 1.1 kg as printed (the page's own 2.42 lb is its conversion; the gram value is the kilogram figure, no conversion of ours).

Partial facts not filed as lists (a covered list must be the source's complete list): the History main page says the console has 'four controller ports'; the Expansion Pak is mentioned. media, ports, controls stay uncovered until a maker manual enumerates them.

external_ids: Wikidata Q184839 confirmed through the Wikidata API (label 'Nintendo 64'); igdb_platform 'n64' is Wikidata's P5795 (Internet Game Database platform ID) on that item, IGDB itself refuses automated fetches (403).
